title.suggested: Allen and Kelly doubt Fitzsimmons can club with his arms

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that ring veterans Tom Allen and Tom Kelly scoffed at the idea that Bob Fitzsimmons or any pugilist could fight successfully by clubbing with the arms or wrists.

metadata.notes: Masthead: Sunday Morning, St. Louis Post-Dispatch, December 2, 1894, page 11. Article headed 'Learning How Fitz Fights: Corbett Practicing Dodges for the Clubbing Blow.'

notes: Allen's view is paraphrased, not quoted; no biographical facts.
